name: @newrole/job-index
description: newrole.it's engine for finding new job offers: it keeps an index of offers read from employers' ATS boards and career sites (@newrole/ats), refreshes it on a schedule, watches companies, discovers boards from catalogs and web search, imports offline harvests, and runs a live search ranked against a profile. Stores in Postgres through the Prisma client its app binds.
